summary: Build the iOS Fabric XCFramework with the repository-pinned Nix Rust toolchain and explicit Apple compilers instead of ambient rustup state.

compatibility.detail: No Fabric wire or app-state change; the compiler and both iOS target standard libraries are pinned together by the existing fenix lock.

downtime.detail: No live scheduler activation or device installation is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: macOS iOS builders need Nix on the build PATH and must be able to build the repository's ios-rust-toolchain flake output, including fetching its pinned compiler and both target standard libraries. The operator separately repins the scheduler's ST_IOS_SCRIPT and ST_IOS_REF to the reviewed delivery source; this change does not modify scheduler configuration or replace existing rustup installations.

recovery.detail: Existing delivery failure and rollback handling is unchanged; toolchain resolution failure stops the build before producing a new XCFramework.
